name: dbstudio-desktop
description: DbStudio desktop shell: a fast SQL client for SQL Server, Oracle and SQLite
author: DbStudio contributors

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/engine-process.test.mjs test/ipc-validate.test.mjs test/smoke.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test test/engine-process.test.mjs test/ipc-validate.test.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
